content: This paper is organized as follows. In Section SECREF2 we discuss our model, which consists of an LSTM module for Chinese word segmentation, a boundary assembling step for more accurate word segmentation, and a CRF module for NER. We show the experiment results and discuss the model performance in Section SECREF3. We conclude in Section SECREF4.
